products.title: Mixology Workshop
products.body_html: Indulge in a fun, hands-on mixology class where you’ll learn to shake up unique creations and enjoy them with some delicious bites on the side.

products.title: Chocolate Making & Tasting
products.body_html: Immerse yourself in a hands-on chocolate-making and tasting session where you'll learn the art of crafting chocolates from an expert. Explore a variety of rich flavors and techniques, and enjoy the creative process of making your own sweet treats to take home.

products.title: Wine & Cheese Tasting
products.body_html: A sensory evening of wine, cheese, and charming conversations. Learn about wine etiquette, pairings, and tasting notes while enjoying three unique wines with a variety of cheeses. Add in conversations, fun wine games, and you’ve got the perfect mix of learning and leisure.

products.title: Pottery Workshop
products.body_html: Build something beautiful with your own hands in this calming pottery workshop. Learn foundational clay techniques, enjoy a drink, and shape two ceramic pieces under expert guidance. Your creations will be fired, glazed, and delivered. A perfect blend of creativity, patience, and a personal touch.
